lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: سَاهُونَ is in the derivative form: ساهون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/هـ/و s–h–w to be inattentive, absent‐minded, distracted; well‐disposed. Of this root, onlyساهون sāhūn occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ساهون sāhūn [pl. of act. part. ساه sāhin] inattentive, heedless, forgetful, neglectful

(107:5) الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاَتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ those who are heedless of their prayer.
